results.title: Russia is selling gas to China at half price — because it has to.
results.description:
Russia is selling gas to China at half price — because it has to.

Duma documents show Beijing pays about $248 per 1,000 cubic metres for Gazprom pipeline gas in 2026, vs $562 for other foreign buyers. A 56% discount.

That is what losing your best customer looks like.

results.title: Russia currently sells Urals crude to India and China at FOB discounts typically $15-25/bbl below Brent (now ~$107), though high Asia freigh
results.description: Russia currently sells Urals crude to India and China at FOB discounts typically $15-25/bbl below Brent (now ~$107), though high Asia freight (~$25-30/bbl) often brings delivered prices near parity or a small premium. China also takes ESPO at narrower discounts. Pipeline gas via Power of Siberia averages ~$248 per 1,000 m³, a 50-56% discount versus other Russian export prices.
